scope: Controlled temporary API on staging data; existing staging and production services not reconfigured or restarted.

method.warmupExcluded: Three traversals of four cases per mode; no database page flush.
method.transport: urllib HTTP/1.1, fresh uncompressed HTTP connection per call over the staging Docker bridge; no TLS/Nginx/browser.
method.resourceBudgets: Temporary API 1.5 CPU, 2 GiB RAM, 4 GiB total RAM+swap, pool 8; background jobs disabled in temporary API.
method.flags: Baseline: new cache master off. Responses: master+response on, monthly/reference/progress off. Existing legacy TTL caches remain in both modes.
method.correlation: Unique numeric testRequestId on every measured request, exact one-to-one server-event correlation; discovery/warmup/401/profile excluded.
method.hostGuard: Stop test after five consecutive one-second samples of CPU steal >=50%; retained all samples, no filtering of slow requests.
method.percentile: Linear interpolation at index (n-1)*0.95; no p95 acceptance asserted for diagnostic misses or hit/miss subcohorts below 100.
method.sqlObservation: Pool.query counts and union wall time, including pool acquisition/app scheduling. Direct Client.query transaction statements are not covered. This is not PostgreSQL server execution time.
method.cpuProfile: One additional point read after response TTL expiry; one-millisecond inspector sampling, aggregate frames only; exploratory and excluded from cohort.

limitations: Fixed phase order, shared host and differing host steal prevent attributing all latency differences to the response cache.
Actual published staging database remains uncapped and its existing API still runs jobs; this does not validate the newly prepared four-service topology.
Only the dedicated staging administrator, one project and one group. No viewer/division/write invalidation/concurrency acceptance or production trial.
Sampled cgroup memory is not a long-duration memory bound or a leak assessment.
Point miss CPU profile is a single request on a contended host, not stable-host proof for another calculation rewrite.

deployedSmoke.surface: existing deployed backend over Docker bridge
